title: Mixing: Name And Address, Children Children by Wings | 1977
content:
Studio Three, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

A mixing session for Wings’ sixth studio album London Town took place on 30 March 1977.

The band had been working on the album since mid-February, and two songs – ‘Name And Address’ and ‘Children Children’ – were judged to be complete. They were mixed in stereo on this day.
